name: world-id
description: Install one World ID hub for the official benefit catalog, AgentMail, and Maître.

interface.longDescription: Install one World ID hub to discover the official production benefit catalog and use AgentMail or Maître without installing their MCP servers separately. Each provider still requires its own one-time OAuth consent when first used. Experimental and unpublished services are excluded.
defaultPrompt: Show me the current official World ID benefits.
Connect AgentMail and show my agent inboxes.
Find a Maître table for two in San Francisco.
